name: What an impact scan asks to run again

values.gloss: a hunch checked against texts again

routes.the-stacks: POST /api/hunches/{hid}/commission — a new pass over the hunch's bundle ({worker} optional; the frame re-runs after)

values.gloss: his references re-read against the texts

routes.the-mastermind: POST /v1/dossier/jobs/{id}/steps {engine_key: reference_reread} on a job that already holds the texts (preferred when the retest names a dossier id)

values.gloss: the evidential frame re-asked (what would change this verdict)

routes.the-stacks: the hunch-frame job after every pass (hunches.frame_job); POST /api/hunches/{hid}/frame when the first retest asks for it

values.gloss: the interlocutors read again on the new formulation

routes.the-mastermind: POST /v1/dossier/jobs/{id}/steps interlocutor_position then distinction_draft, with the new formulation as the turn and the parts beside

note: The Stacks' reaction-follow-up practice names what each run means on the Brief; each value carries the routes that run it, per organ (the Stacks named theirs, 2026-09-07 18:20).
